system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — West Corporation realized record after going-private, ~3-5-year horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier describes ONLY the realized
> record after the transaction closed. It contains no information about how the
> transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On October 20, 2017 West Corporation filed a Form 15-12B, certifying termination of
  its duty to file reports under Section 12(g)/13/15(d) of the Exchange Act for its
  common stock, and reporting approximately one holder of record of the class as of the
  certification date; the form lists "None" for any other class of securities for which
  a reporting duty remained. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-315290, Form 15-12B]
- No Form 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K was filed under West Corporation's CIK (1024657) after
  October 2017; a search of SEC EDGAR for registrants named "West Technology Group,"
  "Intrado Corporation," or "West Corp" filed under other names returned no additional
  currently-reporting registrant tied to this business. Consequently no audited public
  financial statements are available under this or a successor registrant for the
  ~2020-2022 outcome window. [SRC: SEC EDGAR company-search results for CIK 1024657
  submissions history and company-name searches, https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar]
- Because the business was taken private and no successor SEC registrant was located,
  the realized post-close record for the fixed ~2020-2022 outcome window relies on
  company press releases; the facts below are press-sourced, and no financial-scalar
  claim (net income/loss, revenue, impairment, etc.) meets this dossier's primary-source
  bar for the window. [UNVERIFIED: quantitative financial trajectory for 2020-2022]

## Realized business record under private ownership (press-sourced)
- On June 25, 2019, the company (still controlled by affiliates of funds managed by
  Apollo Global Management, LLC) announced a rebrand from "West Corporation" to
  "Intrado," reorganizing its previously reported segment structure into four newly
  named units: Life & Safety, Enterprise Collaboration, Digital Media, and Health &
  Wellness. [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2019/06/25/1874053/0/en/West-Corporation-Announces-Rebrand-to-Intrado.html]
- On September 16, 2022 (within the ~3-5-year window), Intrado Corporation — described
  in the release as "controlled by affiliates of certain funds managed by Apollo Global
  Management, Inc. (NYSE: APO)" — announced a definitive agreement for Stonepeak-advised
  investment funds to acquire Intrado's Safety business (its public emergency
  telecommunications/911-infrastructure operations) for $2.4 billion, with Intrado
  retaining its separate Digital Workflows segment; closing was expected in the first
  quarter of 2023. [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/09/16/2517685/25418/en/Stonepeak-to-Acquire-Safety-Business-from-Intrado.html]
- On November 15, 2022 (at the outer edge of / just beyond the ~5-year window), Intrado
  Corporation announced that its holding company was being rebranded again, to "West
  Technology Group, LLC," with the Intrado brand name itself transitioning to the Safety
  business ahead of its divestiture; the announcement listed the group's remaining
  operating businesses as Notified, Mosaicx, TeleVox, SchoolMessenger, West Utilities,
  and West Telecom, plus the Safety business pending sale to Stonepeak, and again
  described the holding company as controlled by affiliates of Apollo Global Management
  funds. [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/11/15/2556638/25418/en/Intrado-Corporation-Announces-Holding-Company-Rebrand-to-West-Technology-Group-LLC.html]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the company deregistered its equity in October 2017 and no successor entity
  resumed SEC reporting, there is no audited public financial record for the ~2020-2022
  outcome window; the traceable realized record is limited to the company's own press
  releases and consists of two full brand/holding-company reorganizations (to "Intrado"
  in 2019, then to "West Technology Group, LLC" in 2022) bracketing an announced
  agreement, within the window, to divest what had been the business's flagship Safety
  (911-infrastructure) segment for $2.4 billion, with that divestiture's closing itself
  falling just after the window. The case is coded uncertain on the outcome per the
  no-record rule: no primary financial trajectory is available, though the sourced
  record does show repeated corporate restructuring and a significant announced
  segment divestiture within the window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-315290, Form
  15-12B] [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/09/16/2517685/25418/en/Stonepeak-to-Acquire-Safety-Business-from-Intrado.html]

[SLICE END]
